decision.reasoning_trace: During this shopping session, I evaluated a variety of Bluetooth speakers ranging from budget-friendly portable units to high-end home audio systems. I immediately filtered out several accessory items that appeared in the feed, such as carrying cases and wall shelves. My consideration set focused on products with strong ratings and clear value propositions: the premium Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6, the highly-reviewed budget EDUPLINK and INSMY models, the feature-rich NOTABRICK, and the high-fidelity Audio Pro Addon. I ultimately selected the Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 as the final choice. Despite being priced higher than the budget models, its reputation for superior audio quality, 'thumping' bass, and IPX7 waterproofing makes it the most compelling value for a serious listener at $159.99.
